items.name: theme
items.title: Ndigo theme
items.description: Ndigo brand tokens (--nd-*) plus the opt-in base layer for native elements.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Import `styles/ndigo-tokens.css` before the base layer. Set `data-theme="light"` for the light palette; leaving it unset follows the operating system.

items.name: lib
items.title: Ndigo element foundation
items.description: Shared light-DOM custom-element base and the Zag.js machine controller.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy-in foundation for `<nd-*>` elements: the `NdElement` lifecycle base and `createZagElement`.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with focus trapping, dismissal, and ARIA wiring from the Zag.js dialog machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with roving highlight, typeahead, and dismissal from the Zag.js menu machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Native-first button styles with variants and sizes; no runtime and no custom element.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-button` to a native `<button>` (or `<a href>` for navigation). Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes: sm, md, lg.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Responsive application frame with a skip link, banner, primary nav, sidebar, main landmark, and footer.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy the markup into a layout and replace the `<main>` contents; keep the skip link first and the landmarks unique.
